"import cadquery as cq

# Hard-coded parameters (mm)
OUTER_DIAMETER = 80.0   # outer diameter -> radius 40
BORE_DIAMETER = 50.0    # coaxial through bore -> radius 25
HEIGHT = 25.0           # height along Z

# Build the annular sleeve: outer circle minus inner circle, extruded from z=0 upward
part = (
    cq.Workplane("XY", origin=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
    .circle(OUTER_DIAMETER / 2.0)
    .circle(BORE_DIAMETER / 2.0)
    .extrude(HEIGHT)
)

# Validate the resulting single solid
solid = part.val()
assert solid.ShapeType() == "Solid", f"Expected a Solid, got {solid.ShapeType()}"
assert solid.isValid(), "Shape is not a valid B-Rep solid"
assert solid.Volume() > 0.0, "Solid volume must be positive"

# Sanity checks (deterministic, no randomness)
bb = solid.BoundingBox()
assert abs(bb.xlen - OUTER_DIAMETER) < 1e-6
assert abs(bb.ylen - OUTER_DIAMETER) < 1e-6
assert abs(bb.zlen - HEIGHT) < 1e-6
assert abs(bb.zmin) < 1e-9 and abs(bb.zmax - HEIGHT) < 1e-9

# Exactly one cylindrical face at R=40 and one at R=25
cyl_radii = []
for face in solid.Faces():
    if face.geomType() == "CYLINDER":
        cyl_radii.append(face._geomAdaptor().Cylinder().Radius())
assert cyl_radii.count(40.0) == 1, f"Expected exactly 1 outer cylindrical face, got {cyl_radii}"
assert cyl_radii.count(25.0) == 1, f"Expected exactly 1 bore cylindrical face, got {cyl_radii}"
# Expected faces: outer cyl, bore cyl, top annulus, bottom annulus
assert len(solid.Faces()) == 4, f"Expected 4 faces total, got {len(solid.Faces())}"

# Export to current working directory
cq.exporters.export(part, "part.step")

print("Exported part.step")
print(f"Volume: {solid.Volume():.6f} mm^3")
print(f"Bounding box: {bb.xmin:.6f} {bb.ymin:.6f} {bb.zmin:.6f} -> {bb.xmax:.6f} {bb.ymax:.6f} {bb.zmax:.6f}")"
